title: The moduli category of proper algebraic-space curves and its infinitesimal automorphisms
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and use the algebraic spaces over $S$ of [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Write $h_T$ for the representable presheaf of an $S$-scheme $T$. For a map of presheaves $F\to G$, its point map is the map on field-valued point classes induced by applying the map to representatives; point classes and their atlas topology are [def-a1-space-point-topology]. A map of algebraic spaces is quasi-compact if its pullback along every affine scheme mapping to the target has compact underlying point space. Its diagonal is the canonical map into its sheaf fibre product with itself. For $X$ an algebraic space and $f:X\to h_T$, separated means that its diagonal is representable by closed immersions, and universally closed means that after every scheme base change the induced point map is closed [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Flatness, locally finite type and locally finite presentation are tested on every representable etale scheme chart of $X$, using the corresponding scheme properties [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. A proper family of curves over $T$ consists of $X$ and $f$, with $f$ flat, proper (separated, quasi-compact, locally finite type and universally closed), of finite presentation (quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally of finite presentation), and with every geometric fibre of topological Krull dimension at most one [def-weil-geometric-fibre], [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Here quasi-separated means quasi-compact diagonal, and geometric fibres are tested on algebraically closed fields [def-weil-field], [def-weil-algebraic-closure] in the universe of the big site. The total category $\mathfrak C_S$ has objects these families together with their bases $T$, and an arrow over $T'\to T$ is a cartesian square of the underlying presheaves. Identity and composition are the actual identity and composite maps; identity squares are cartesian and pasting cartesian squares is cartesian. The projection remembers $T$ and the base arrow.

For a field $\Omega$ and $a:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$, put $D=\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{DualNumber}\Omega)$ [def-sc-dual-numbers], with its structure map $p:D\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ and reduction $i:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to D$ induced respectively by inclusion and projection of the dual-number ring. For any presheaf $F$ over $h_{\operatorname{Spec}\Omega}$, its constant dual-number thickening is the presheaf fibre product $F_D=F\times_{h_{\operatorname{Spec}\Omega}}h_D$, with canonical reduction map $F\to F_D$. Say it has trivial infinitesimal automorphisms if every natural automorphism of $F_D$ preserving its projection to $h_D$ and restricting to the identity along this reduction map is the identity. No condition of fixing the projection to $F$ is imposed.
